author: MrDogPT
body:
Hello guys, I'm happy to introduce you the :
AvicuSchool.
I made this map all alone, but {tag=f3a45beadbde479181550988b644ac3b} helped me with details and stuff.
Information
-------//------
Gamemode: DTM
Monuments: 2
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/1tEIT
Green team vs Blue team
Alexanderjoe's server,
-----//----
Extra info:
 -The map may be to small, but I would like to have opinions about the map still.
 - I made this map in 3 hours
 - I hope you like it!
Regards
xToby.

replies.body:
I like the idea of the map but there could be some changes.

-It looks wayy to cramped at the moment (especially in the monument area).
-Could you maybe explain where the spawn is because it's in the same area as the monument which could make it soo stale.
-Maybe make middle bigger and add some pvp space if you want a structure.
-Make the buildings less plain. They look boring with the cobblestone & wood theme.

The map looks incredible from what I could see from screenshots, but I think you need to fix this, remove those "spheres" from WE and consider adding shape and add some stone under the dirt if you want.
And also, the map will be day or night? If you decide to make the map on night, I highly recommend to you add some torches because it looks very dark.

Good luck with your map!

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I'm sorry to say but your map has been denied for the following reasons:

World Edit: This needs to be fixed
Space for PVP: There is barely any making the gameplay bland and boring
Too much structures: As stated above, the map is cramped.

You may resubmit your map if you wish once you fix these issues.
